summary: Review critical paths for actionable telemetry, correlation, failure detection, recovery signals and incident-safe diagnostics without treating logging volume as reliability.

must_inspect.why: Material failure modes need evidence that operators can detect and localize them in time.
false_positive_guards: Do not require bespoke metrics when platform-level telemetry already proves equivalent observability.

must_inspect.why: Operational diagnostics must avoid leaking secrets or sensitive payloads while preserving enough context to debug.
false_positive_guards: Do not call absence of payload logging an observability defect when safer identifiers suffice.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
